item.title: Supreme Court strikes down key Trump-Era tariffs; small businesses face uncertainty
item.description: A major ruling from the U.S. Supreme Court is reshaping national trade policy, and small businesses here in Las Vegas said they’re watching closely.

item.title: Las Vegas continues to be a terrorism target, sheriff says
item.description: Las Vegas Metro Police Department Sheriff Kevin McMahill announced the launch of the Meridian Project, a technologically advanced program to protect Las Vegas from terrorist attacks, which will include a 24/7 global intelligence and counter-terrorism capability, a 24/7 real-time analysis desk, and a global intelligence network in key cities and international locations.

item.title: Las Vegas union leader remembers Jesse Jackson's leadership at crucial time
item.description: The Rev. Jesse Jackson showed up for unions in Las Vegas, and Culinary Union leader Ted Pappageorge called him a hero for working people in Las Vegas.

item.title: Auction would open 233 acres for builders in Las Vegas, raise money for parks
item.description: Land near Kyle Canyon Road in the northwest Las Vegas valley is part of 233 acres expected to be auctioned by the U.S. Bureau of Land Management.

item.title: Las Vegas military veteran's dispute with mortgage lender stymied by national politics
item.description: An elderly Marine veteran's dispute with his mortgage servicer may be exacerbated by the after-effects of the Trump administration's dismantling of a federal agency designed to help consumers dissatisfied with their banks and other financial institutions, an 8 News Now investigation reveals.

item.title: New York man dead after ramming power substation outside Las Vegas
item.description: One person is dead after he rammed a power substation outside Boulder City, sources told the 8 News Now Investigators.

item.title: Las Vegas Metro police investigate homicide at burning home
item.description: LAS VEGAS (KLAS) -- 8 News Now has learned that Las Vegas Metro police are investigating a homicide north of Reid Airport. Officers responded to a home near Tropicana Avenue and Spencer Street on Friday shortly after 9 p.m., where they found the home on fire. Stay with 8 News Now for updates.
